title: #smallpoems Does one whisper histories To the Ghost of Christmas Never Was? Dribbling deeply into Holiday mysteries Sibling memories seeping past Time
summary: #smallpoems Does one whisper histories To the Ghost of Christmas Never Was? Dribbling deeply into Holiday mysteries Sibling memories seeping past Time sleeping In The Next Place Glances stolen In your cousin's face hands out stretched To a present not Far fetched With our Souls to Catch your dreams
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
Does one whisper
histories
To the
Ghost of
Christmas Never Was?

Dribbling deeply into
Holiday mysteries
Sibling memories
seeping past
Time sleeping
In The Next Place

Glances stolen
In your cousin's face
hands out stretched
To a present not
Far fetched

With our
Souls to
Catch your dreams
